title: Find every caller and export of the startup recorder hand-off
prompt:
In the desktop app's startup diagnostics, `retain_recorder` hands a recorder child process to a background thread that waits on it. Those waits die when the observer restarts, so the function is being replaced by a detached supervisor. Find every Rust file, integration tests included, that defines, re-exports or calls `retain_recorder`.

Write the answer to `bench-answer.txt` at the repository root: one repository-relative path per line (for example `path/to/file.rs`), each file once, nothing else on the line. List files, not line numbers. Do not change any other file.
notes: Small (5 files), Rust only: src-tauri/src/startup and src-tauri/tests. Recall must be 1; one wrong file is allowed.
